as_told.title: Kirsan Ilyumzhinov says aliens took him onto a spaceship in 1997

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, speaking with fellow podcaster Joe Rogan, says he once interviewed the president of Kalmykia, a Buddhist republic inside Russia near Dagestan. According to Michels, the man says he was abducted by aliens in the 1990s while he was the sitting president. If true, it would mean the leader of a whole region claimed a direct encounter while in office.
